about: The area config for one study round over the league (#8005 slice 5; docs/IA.md §5.7: everyone's standing and everyone's fills — the leaderboard with its match, field and compare, the Activity feed with booked P&L, and each account's public page they open). Read by scripts/study/round.mjs; everything area-specific lives here or in scripts/study/worlds/league-*. Worlds, all on bot-loop-today's league (the pin's Monday, the pin as corpus, two bots and their owners): league-today (the league as it stands), league-read-failed (the same day with the friend's own account unreadable at the instant: the field ranks the other three and says nothing of it, §5.7's 'fails open') and league-first-day (a member who linked a paper account this morning joins the field). Phone first: 7 of the 10 frames are phones. Members start where the app nav's Activity link lands, except those who come to the league from a league card's link to the full board. Census routes are links the league builds (a row's name, a row's Compare), never composed. `roles` is who each member is here, in plain words, read by the experts and the words pass instead of the cards (#5099), so it never quotes a card. No sealed key, framer or tasks yet: those come when the cross-feature round clears (#8005).

roles.eric: Runs the league and owns one of its two bots; checks how everyone is doing against everyone else and what was traded today. On a phone when away, at a desk at home.
roles.invited-friend: A friend the owner invited, with one small account and a bot of their own; wants to know where they stand and what others are trading. On a phone.
roles.bot-watcher: Owns no account at all; follows the league's bots against its people the way a fan follows a table, and reads who traded what. On a phone.
roles.phone-only: Uses the app only on a phone, one-handed, a minute or two at a time.
roles.returning-trader: Has one paper account and some options vocabulary, and is back after some weeks away; wants to see what changed in the standings and who traded what while they were gone. Uses a phone and a desk.
roles.first-timer: Invited last week and linked a paper account this morning; owns no bot and has traded nothing yet. On a laptop.

pages: a table of every account in the league, bots and people alike, ranked by a figure the member picks: equity, the month's return, unrealized or realized gains, return on open positions
a running match between the league's bots and its people, with each side's totals
two accounts picked from the table and compared side by side
every account's trades, newest first, grouped by day, with filters by side, by bots or people, and by text
each account's booked gains and losses, side by side
one account's own public page: what it holds and where it stands in the league
where these pages send the member next: an account's own page from a row or a trade, and back
